authorityRules.owner: Native Desktop Owner token derived from verified Portal Owner + PKCE; Redis family and Operator live session revalidated. Never an Agent grant.
authorityRules.agent: Device/Agent/session-bound A/B authorization and local policy remain mandatory.
authorityRules.internalOperator: Private Unix socket, exact verified Owner/session purpose; not a public unauthenticated route.
authorityRules.wall: Same-device Owner/CSRF/origin and signed B checks; not implied by native login.

ownerAuthorize.response: Verified Owner HTML consent -> one-use loopback authorization code

ownerRefresh.response: Same token model; refresh token is atomically consumed, live Owner family rechecked

ownerSession.request: Native-only Authorization Bearer, no browser Origin/cookie

ownerSnapshot.response: Bounded Owner viewport or strict typed Owner-bound page; source/coverage/retention fields required as applicable

operatorOwnerSnapshot.request: Verified native Owner/accountSessionId purpose over private socket, optional typed page
operatorOwnerSnapshot.response: Owner-scoped snapshot/pages from real device/grant registries, PG job ledger and Redis retained sessions

ownerLogout.response: Family revoked, native vault/session cleared by client; no Agent grant mutation

ownerWallTicket.request: Native Owner bearer + exact owned device; mTLS/pinned trusted edge
ownerWallTicket.response: One-use short ticket bound to Owner family/device, delivered by signed device relay
ownerWallTicket.flagsSource: operator-host/desktop-wall-sso-operator-gate-v4.mjs exports DESKTOP_WALL_SSO_OPERATOR_REQUIRED_FLAGS + DESKTOP_WALL_SSO_ISSUER_FLAG_V4; mTLS edge has its separate flag

wallBApprove.request: Authenticated local Owner, CSRF, explicit B, signed pending request/device binding
wallBApprove.response: Durable scoped grant only after all independent consent checks

wallModulesRead.response: Persisted owner-identity partition + monotonically increasing local module revision

wallModulesConfigure.request: Explicit desired state + expectedRevision CAS + Owner/CSRF
wallModulesConfigure.response: Persisted new state or 409; disabling Memory does not delete data

nonClaims: A route in source is not DEPLOYED/ENABLED.
A source/CI PASS is not PHYSICAL_PASS.
Snapshot TTL/historyMs are not an immutable audit archive.
